comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/drawing-curved-outline.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1909): a solid pipe bend, Body1 (F2.b0): Sketch1's circle of radius 20 at (50, 0) on XY turned 120 degrees about the Y axis the negative way (Revolve1, F2), from its end on XY (z 0, x 30 to 70) over the top (its outer side, a torus of 70 about Y, highest at x 0, z 70: no end of an edge there, the revolution's seam runs on through it) round to its other end (x -35 to -15). Drawing1 (D1, A3) has its front view at 1:1 with its box (x -35 to 70, z 0 to 70) in the middle at (147.5, 150): the model's (x, z) on the sheet at (130 + x, 115 + z), whole millimetres; and a section through it at x 20 (sheet x 150), view 2, beside it at (330, 150). All geometry is synthetic.
